notes:
REF-BM-02: Save does not fetch page metadata, favicon, or preview image.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but bookmark notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-06: POST always creates a new bookmark and performs no duplicate-URL check.
REF-BM-07: List items expose title, description, and tags, but no favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag input has no autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and URL but not notes.
REF-BM-14: No #tag query syntax is implemented.
REF-BM-15: Search has no Boolean operators or parenthesized expression parsing.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases receive no exact-match handling.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: No multi-selection or bulk actions exist.
REF-BM-21: No whole-filtered-collection action exists.
REF-BM-22: No list sorting controls or sort logic exist.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and Markdown rendering are unsupported.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML snapshot or PDF preservation exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-26: No archive state or default-list exclusion exists.
REF-BM-27: Archive is unavailable, so reversible archive cannot be distinguished from deletion.
REF-BM-28: No archived-only list exists.
REF-BM-29: No saved-filter bundle entity or workflow exists.
REF-BM-30: No Netscape HTML import exists.
REF-BM-31: No Netscape HTML export exists.
REF-BM-32: No display-related personal settings exist.
